options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: cert_params
options.description: Certificate parameters to generate signing request.

options.name: certificate_path
options.description: Absolute path of the certificate file if I(command) is C(import). Directory path with write permissions if I(command) is C(generate_csr) or C(export).

options.name: certificate_type
options.description: Type of the iDRAC certificate. C(HTTPS) The Dell self-signed SSL certificate. C(CA) Certificate Authority(CA) signed SSL certificate. C(CUSTOMCERTIFICATE) The custom PKCS12 certificate and private key. Export of custom certificate is supported only on iDRAC firmware version 7.00.00.00 and above. C(CSC) The custom signing SSL certificate. C(CLIENT_TRUST_CERTIFICATE) Client trust certificate.

options.name: command
options.description: C(generate_csr), generate CSR. This requires I(cert_params) and I(certificate_path). This is applicable only for C(HTTPS) C(import), import the certificate file. This requires I(certificate_path). C(export), export the certificate. This requires I(certificate_path). C(reset), reset the certificate to default settings. This is applicable only for C(HTTPS).

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: passphrase
options.description: The passphrase string if the certificate to be imported is passphrase protected.

options.name: reset
options.description: To reset the iDRAC after the certificate operation. This is applicable when I(command) is C(import) or C(reset).

options.name: ssl_key
options.description: Absolute path of the private or SSL key file. This is applicable only when I(command) is C(import) and I(certificate_type) is C(HTTPS). Uploading the SSL key to iDRAC is supported on firmware version 6.00.02.00 and above.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: wait
options.description: Maximum wait time for iDRAC to start after the reset, in seconds. This is applicable when I(command) is C(import) or C(reset) and I(reset) is C(true).

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export IDRAC_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
